'''R'terleD'er''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Kriz sector/Legends|Kriz sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], hunters on R'terleD'er were known to pay Baragwins handsomely to track large game.<ref name="GG12" />
